== Historical image ==
The E-marked PC face is present by 8 July 2018; the distinct D-E1 rendering was published 27 January 2024. The game wording is unchanged. The source images are retained on their File pages. The earlier image has no separate implemented GEMP state; the current family remains <code>2_50</code>. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).

== 2017 source occurrence ==
The sheet edition and repository imports identify preserved source occurrences; they do not establish unknown first-publication days. In particular, the full face in the initial 2018 import may predate that import, so its original first-publication order relative to the 2017 partial is not independently established. The dated occurrences therefore do not independently settle their original publication sequence. The preserved full-face discussion moves with its image; the 2017 source is [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Official PC Decipher Errata sheet]], official text as of 1 June 2017, page 24.
